tracks.title: Python Quest
tracks.blurb: From your first print() to writing your own functions.

tracks.title: Debug the Outage
tracks.blurb: Fix broken servers in a simulated terminal.

regions.title: First Steps
regions.blurb: Say hello, remember things, read input.
regions.story: Chilaka's village, Aata-gram, lost its welcome gate. Learn print, variables and input to rebuild it.

regions.title: Decisions
regions.story: The signposts at the crossroads are tangled. Use if, elif and else to point every traveller the right way.

regions.title: Loops
regions.story: The village water wheel has stopped. Loops keep it turning without writing the same line a hundred times.

regions.title: Strings
regions.story: The market stalls sell words, and the labels are jumbled. Text tools will sort them out.

regions.title: Collections
regions.story: The library shelves have collapsed. Collections hold many things in an order you choose.

regions.title: Functions
regions.story: The workshop needs tools that can be used again and again. Build your own functions.

regions.title: Files and Errors
regions.story: Letters are piling up at the post office. Files store them, and error handling keeps one bad letter from stopping everything.

regions.title: Modules and Debugging
regions.story: The toolshed is full of ready-made tools. Learn to import them, and to track down bugs when something breaks.

regions.title: Objects
regions.blurb: Bundle data and behaviour in classes.
regions.story: The guild hall keeps records of every member. Classes let you model real things in code.

regions.title: Clean Code
regions.story: The tower is messy. Names, tests and small functions make code clear for the next reader.

regions.title: Problem Solving
regions.blurb: Think in steps, search, sort, solve.
regions.story: The garden maze hides the way out. Algorithms are how you find it quickly.

regions.title: Real-World Python
regions.blurb: Parse logs, read APIs, build tools.
regions.story: The control room watches the whole village. Use Python to read logs, parse data and build command-line tools.

regions.title: Debug the Outage
regions.blurb: Linux troubleshooting, one outage at a time.
regions.story: A pager buzzes at 3 a.m. Fix the broken server before the village wakes.
